eps.t: I Want to Talk About My Memories
eps.ov: After five years, Tino nostalgically recalls his first encounter with the Grieving Souls and Krai.

eps.t: At This Rate, I'd Rather Be Somewhere Else
eps.ov: House Gradis directly requests Krai for a job. To get out of it he goes on vacation.

eps.t: I Want to Leave the City's Peace to You
eps.ov: Krai enjoys his vacation, but Arnold who's in pursuit him is having the worst time.

eps.t: I'll Pass on the Strong Monsters
eps.ov: Krai's vacation continues, and so do the hardships for Arnold and the others chasing him.

eps.t: I Want to Soak It Up in the Hot Springs
eps.ov: Krai and the rest finally made it to the hot springs. Now he can enjoy the all luxuries, or can he?

eps.t: Somehow or Another, I'd Like to Get Out
eps.ov: Krai's vacation gets interrupted again, now the Barrel bandit gang and underground people enter the fray too.

eps.t: I Want to Hand Out Gifts to Everyone
eps.ov: The Gathering of the White Blades was postponed so Krai has to attend. Of course it gets disrupted.

eps.t: I'd Rather Skip the Escort Quest
eps.ov: In order to protect the Emperor, Krai assembles a team. The first day's uneventful, but it's not quite over.

eps.t: The Nine-Tailed Fox Wants to Move in the Shadows
I'm Grateful for the Assistance of My Friends
eps.ov: Friendly ghosts come to help Krai, and Telm reveals his true motives.

eps.t: I Want to Have a Big Laugh at the End
eps.ov: The airship gets locked in the sky by a great force even Liz and Luke can't penetrate. Who's behind it?
